items.title: CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Notification Out For 1703 Assistant Registration, Clerk & More Posts, Apply Online
items.description: CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Notification Out For 1703 Assistant Registration, Clerk & More Posts, Apply Online November 6, 2026
items.doc_text:
Exams » CGSSB Recruitment 2026 The Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board (CGSSB), Raipur, has announced 1,703 vacancies under CGSSB Recruitment 2026 for various Group-2, Class III posts, including Assistant Grade 3, Registration Clerk, Stenographer and Data Entry Operator. The online application process started on 5 November 2026 and will close on 27 November 2026. The written examination is scheduled for 10 January 2027. Candidates can check the complete recruitment details below. CGSSB Recruitment 2026: Overview Candidates interested in the CGSSB vacancies can check the important recruitment details in the table below. Particulars Details Organisation Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board (CGSSB) Recruitment Name CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Advertisement Number एस.एस.बी./परीक्षा एफ-20/2026/4422 Exam Code G20227 Post Names Assistant Grade 3, Registration Clerk, Stenographer & Others Total Vacancies 1,703 Job Location Chhattisgarh Application Mode Online Application Start Date 5 November 2026 Last Date to Apply 27 November 2026 Exam Date 10 January 2027 Selection Process Written Examination Official Website cgssb.cgstate.gov.in CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF The CGSSB Recruitment 2026 notification contains details about vacancies, eligibility criteria, application dates and examination schedules. Candidates can access the official notification PDF through the link provided below to check the recruitment details before applying. Download CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates The board has announced the complete application schedule along with the written examination date. Candidates should keep track of the following dates to avoid missing any important event. Event Date Notification Date 5 November 2026 Online Application Begins 5 November 2026 Last Date to Apply Online 27 November 2026 (5:00 PM) Application Correction Starts 28 November 2026 Last Date for Correction 30 November 2026 (5:00 PM) Admit Card Release (Tentative) 4 January 2027 Written Examination 10 January 2027 CGSSB Vacancy 2026: Post-Wise Details A total of 1,703 vacancies have been announced for 10 different posts. Assistant Grade 3 accounts for the largest share, with 1,206 vacancies, followed by Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (District Unit Cadre), with 279 vacancies. The complete post-wise vacancy distribution is given below. Post Name Vacancies Stenographer (Hindi) 30 Stenographer (English) 3 Stenographer (Bilingual) 13 Sub-Inspector-A (Stenographer), General Branch (Hindi) 34 Data Entry Operator 25 Steno Typist 23 Assistant Grade 3 1,206 Registration Clerk 50 Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (General Branch) 40 Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (District Unit Cadre) 279 Total 1,703 CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link Candidates interested in CGSSB Recruitment 2026 can submit their application forms online through the official website. The application process started on 5 November 2026 and will close on 27 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. The direct application link is provided below. CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link How to Apply Online for CGSSB Recruitment 2026? Candidates can submit their applications online through the official CGSSB website. Follow the step-by-step instructions given below to complete the application process successfully. Visit the official website of CGSSB at cgssb.cgstate.gov.in. Open the recruitment section and find the Group-2, Class III, Sub-Group-02 recruitment notification. Select Advertisement No. एस.एस.बी./परीक्षा एफ-20/2026/4422 (G20227). Click on the online application link and complete the registration process. Enter the required personal, educational and other details in the application form. Upload the necessary documents, photograph and signature in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable examination fee through the available online payment method. Carefully review all the entered details before submitting the application. Download and save the final application form and payment receipt for future reference. 📢 Important Deadline: Candidates must submit their applications by 27 November 2026 (5:00 PM) . Don’t miss the deadline! CGSSB Exam Date and Schedule 2026 The CGSSB written recruitment examination (G20227) will take place on 10 January 2027. The examination will be conducted from 10:00 AM to 12:15 PM at five divisional headquarters in Chhattisgarh. The admit card is tentatively scheduled to be available on the official website from 4 January 2027. Examination Details Schedule Exam Date 10 January 2027 Exam Timing 10:00 AM to 12:15 PM Exam Duration 2 Hours 15 Minutes Exam Centres Five Divisional Headquarters Admit Card Date 4 January 2027 (Tentative) CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria Candidates applying for CGSSB Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age requirements prescribed for their respective posts. CGSSB Educational Qualification 2026 As per previous Chhattisgarh recruitment rules for similar posts, the educational and technical qualifications include the following: Post Name Educational Qualification Assistant Grade 3 12th pass, one-year Diploma/Certificate in Data Entry Operator or Programming, and Hindi computer typing speed of 5,000 key depressions per hour. Stenographer (Hindi) 12th pass, Hindi shorthand speed of 100 words per minute, Hindi computer typing speed of 30 words per minute, and one-year Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma. Stenographer (English) 12th pass, English shorthand speed of 100 words per minute, English computer typing speed of 35 words per minute, and one-year Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma. Stenographer (Bilingual) 12th pass with Hindi and English shorthand and typing qualifications. Steno Typist 12th pass, Hindi shorthand speed of 60 words per minute, Hindi computer typing speed of 25 words per minute, and one-year Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma. Data Entry Operator 12th pass or 10th pass with a three-year diploma, one-year Data Entry Operator/Programming diploma, and prescribed data entry speed. Registration Clerk Refer to the applicable departmental recruitment rules. Sub-Inspector-A (Stenographer), General Branch (Hindi) Refer to the applicable departmental recruitment rules. Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (General Branch) Refer to the applicable departmental recruitment rules. Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (District Unit Cadre) Refer to the applicable departmental recruitment rules. CGSSB Age Limit 2026 Particulars Age Limit Minimum Age 18 years Maximum Age 30 years Maximum Age for Chhattisgarh Domicile Candidates 35 years Age Relaxation Applicable as per Chhattisgarh Government rules CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process The selection of candidates for CGSSB Recruitment 2026 will be based on a written examination conducted by the Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board. Candidates must appear for the examination (G20227), scheduled for 10 January 2027. The selection process includes the following stages: Written Examination: Candidates will have to appear for the prescribed written recruitment examination. Document Verification: Candidates shortlisted based on the examination will undergo document verification to confirm their eligibility and educational qualifications. Final Selection: The final selection will be made according to the examination performance and applicable recruitment rules of the board. CGSSB Recruitment 2026 Salary Candidates selected for CGSSB Recruitment 2026 will receive salaries according to the Chhattisgarh Government pay matrix. Based on previous departmental recruitment rules, the pay scales for similar posts are given below. Post Name Previous Pay Scale Grade Pay Stenographer (Hindi) ₹5,200–20,200 ₹2,800 Stenographer (English) ₹5,200–20,200 ₹2,800 Stenographer (Bilingual) ₹5,200–20,200 ₹2,800 Sub-Inspector-A (Stenographer), General Branch (Hindi) Varies by cadre – Data Entry Operator ₹5,200–20,200 ₹2,200–2,400 Steno Typist ₹5,200–20,200 ₹1,900 Assistant Grade 3 ₹5,200–20,200 ₹1,900 Registration Clerk Department-specific scale – Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (General Branch) Department-specific scale – Assistant Sub-Inspector-A (District Unit Cadre) Department-specific scale – Must Check: WBSSC Group C And D Result 2026 Out Join Our Telegram Channel Group About the Author Anshika Author Anshika is a Content Writer at Adda247, specializing in educational content, government exams, and SEO-driven writing. She has studied at Delhi University and has 2 years of experience in content writing. She creates informative articles on recruitment notifications, exam dates, results, and exam preparation. With a focus on research, accuracy, and clarity, she simplifies complex information into student-friendly content, helping government job aspirants stay informed and prepare effectively for competitive examinations.
